correctness.rationale: For all 0<δ<1/2 and 0<m<2δ, the actual RESULT.md radius analysis has four regimes. On |x|≤δ the candidate r=1+δ-|x| dominates since the cap ρc=1-2δ+m bounds every shorter radius by (1+ρc)/2 and later regimes decrease. Tower interiors have maximal average 1; for |x|≥1+δ a numerator bound N(r)≤1+k(r-(|x|-δ)) with k=(1+m)/(1+2δ) and k-ρc=2δ(2δ-m)/(1+2δ)>0 forces one of two endpoint radii. Their crossover gives x*=(1+3δ+mδ)/(1+m). The above-cap witness concentrates density ρ immediately inside the right gap edge, making the limiting boundary average (1+ρ)/2 exceed the below-cap profile. The mass-feasibility inequality m/(2δ)<ρc is strict; zero-mean bounded perturbations give infinitely many shapes. Independently recomputed exact rational centered critical-radius averages at δ=1/4,m=1/16 for two distinct mass-matched piecewise-constant h at ten centers; both equal the asserted profile. Step checks corroborate but do not establish the universal case.
